directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the Diesel Concrete Spraying Machine at /products/diesel-concrete-spraying-machine. Copy only the printed cells: Model Diesel Concrete Spraying Machine; Power Type Diesel engine; Engine Power 28/32 HP; Output Capacity 5 m³/h; Max. Outlet Pressure 8 MPa; Delivery Distance (H / V) 80 m / 40 m; Hose Diameter 38/51 mm; Max. Particle Size ≤6 mm; Sand-Cement Ratio ≤1:3; Dimensions (L×W×H) 2350 × 750 × 1050 mm; Main Unit Weight 480 kg. For transport, copy Dimensions (L×W×H) is 2350 × 750 × 1050 mm and Main Unit Weight is 480 kg. The printed output cell is 5 m³/h. Compare the pour or spray rate you need with that cell. If the job is larger, open another listed page instead of stretching this number. The printed distance row or rows: Delivery Distance (H / V) 80 m / 40 m. Name horizontal and vertical metres, and name which row you mean. A distance row is not a stone-size cell. The printed power cell is 28/32 HP. Write the site supply next to it: voltage and frequency for an electric row, or diesel if the cell says diesel. Do not swap in a figure from another page. The printed aggregate or particle cell is ≤6 mm. Send the maximum stone or particle size in the mix. If the mix is coarser, this row is the wrong page. OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/diesel-concrete-spraying-machine. Send the change to Xingtai. Do not invent a model name or a performance number the page does not print. No price is printed on the product page. Confirm the price with Xingtai. The photograph on this note is a content image from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fly_ash. It shows: A stack of fly ash bricks. It is a reference picture for the inquiry topic. It is not a Hebei Pinjin Machinery nameplate, not a quotation, and not an export case.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油混凝土喷涂机列在 /products/diesel-concrete-spraying-machine。只抄已印格子：型号 Diesel Concrete Spraying Machine; 动力形式 柴油机; 发动机功率 28/32 HP; 理论输送量 5 m³/h; 最大出口压力 8 MPa; 输送距离（水平/垂直） 80 m / 40 m; 管径 38/51 mm; 最大粒径 ≤6 mm; 砂灰比 ≤1:3; 外形尺寸 2350 × 750 × 1050 mm; 整机重量 480 kg。运输请抄外形尺寸是 2350 × 750 × 1050 mm，整机重量是 480 kg。已印输送量是 5 m³/h。把需要的浇筑或喷涂方量与这一格对照。工程更大时，打开另一条已列页面，不要把这个数字拉长。已印距离行：输送距离（水平/垂直） 80 m / 40 m。询盘写明水平米数、垂直米数，并点明是哪一行。距离行不是石子粒径。已印动力是 28/32 HP。旁边写上现场条件：电动行写电压和频率，格子写柴油就写柴油。不要换成另一页上的数字。已印骨料或粒径是 ≤6 mm。询盘写混合物里的最大石子或粒径。料更粗时，这一行就不是该打开的页面。OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/diesel-concrete-spraying-machine 开始。把要改的内容发给邢台。不要自编型号，也不要写页面没有印的性能数字。产品页没有印价格。价格向邢台询盘确认。这篇配图是 https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fly_ash 页面里的内容图片。画面主体：一摞粉煤灰砖。它只作询盘主题的参考。它不是河北品锦机械的铭牌，不是报价单，也不是出口案例。

Particle Size ≤6 mm; Sand-Cement Ratio ≤1:3; Dimensions (L×W×H) 2350 × 750 × 1050 mm; Main Unit Weight 480 kg. Leave any cell the page does not print empty.
body.zh: 主题里写上 /products/diesel-concrete-spraying-machine。已公布的格子是：型号 Diesel Concrete Spraying Machine; 动力形式 柴油机; 发动机功率 28/32 HP; 理论输送量 5 m³/h; 最大出口压力 8 MPa; 输送距离（水平/垂直） 80 m / 40 m; 管径 38/51 mm; 最大粒径 ≤6 mm; 砂灰比 ≤1:3; 外形尺寸 2350 × 750 × 1050 mm; 整机重量 480 kg。页面没有印的格子保持空白。

heading.en: Output, distance, power and particle size
heading.zh: 输送量、距离、动力和粒径

body.en: The printed output cell is 5 m³/h. Compare the pour or spray rate you need with that cell. If the job is larger, open another listed page instead of stretching this number. The printed distance row or rows: Delivery Distance (H / V) 80 m / 40 m. Name horizontal and vertical metres, and name which row you mean. A distance row is not a stone-size cell. The printed power cell is 28/32 HP. Write the site supply next to it: voltage and frequency for an electric row, or diesel if the cell says diesel. Do not swap in a figure from another page. The printed aggregate or particle cell is ≤6 mm. Send the maximum stone or particle size in the mix. If the mix is coarser, this row is the wrong page.
body.zh: 已印输送量是 5 m³/h。把需要的浇筑或喷涂方量与这一格对照。工程更大时，打开另一条已列页面，不要把这个数字拉长。已印距离行：输送距离（水平/垂直） 80 m / 40 m。询盘写明水平米数、垂直米数，并点明是哪一行。距离行不是石子粒径。已印动力是 28/32 HP。旁边写上现场条件：电动行写电压和频率，格子写柴油就写柴油。不要换成另一页上的数字。已印骨料或粒径是 ≤6 mm。询盘写混合物里的最大石子或粒径。料更粗时，这一行就不是该打开的页面。

heading.en: What to ask Xingtai instead of guessing
heading.zh: 该问邢台，而不是自己猜

body.en: OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/diesel-concrete-spraying-machine. Send the change to Xingtai. Do not invent a model name or a performance number the page does not print. Also send country and purchase timing as facts about your order. Do not turn them into a promised lead time or an export-country list. No price is printed on the product page. Confirm the price with Xingtai.
body.zh: OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/diesel-concrete-spraying-machine 开始。把要改的内容发给邢台。不要自编型号，也不要写页面没有印的性能数字。同时把国家和采购时间作为订单事实发来。不要把它们写成承诺交期，也不要写成出口国名单。产品页没有印价格。价格向邢台询盘确认。
